analysis.original_request:
我正在研发先进封装材料和光刻胶残留的紫外激发光学检测模块。模块以 355 nm 附近的光激发样品，需要压低收集通道中的激发光泄漏，同时保留可见波段的荧光信息，并抑制辅助近红外对准光进入可见探测通道。请设计空气入射、入射角 0 deg、非偏振 unpolarized、熔融石英基底上的平面多层介质滤光膜：在 355-365 nm 和 1030-1080 nm 两个干扰波段分别尽可能降低平均透射率，在 420-700 nm 信号波段尽可能提高平均透射率。膜层仅允许 Ta2O5 和 SiO2，总层数不超过 36 层。
单层膜厚（layer thickness）：20-350 nm。
请通过实际仿真比较不同膜系，分析通带损耗与双阻带抑制的折中，给出材料顺序、厚度和各目标波段结果。评价对象是检测模块中的滤光元件。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric filter on a fused silica substrate with unspecified material incidence for an optical detection module. The filter should minimize average transmittance at 355 nm and in the 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm bands while maximizing average transmittance in the 420-700 nm band. Constraints include 0 deg incidence, unpolarized light, materials limited to Ta2O5 and SiO2, maximum 36 layers, and individual layer thickness between 20-350 nm. Compare different stack designs and analyze trade-offs between passband loss and dual stopband suppression.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar isotropic layered media with linear materials under frequency-domain illumination, fitting the Harness scope.
method_research_questions: trade-off between passband loss and dual stopband suppression
